subject.statement: René Benko was sentenced to two years in prison by the Innsbruck Regional Court in October 2025.

summary: As of my knowledge cutoff in mid‑2024, there is no record of René Benko receiving a prison sentence; subsequent reporting up to late 2025 does not mention a two‑year sentence from the Innsbruck Regional Court in October 2025. Therefore the claim is inaccurate.
